g.text: One step of a journal-owner history on real files
The real owner takes the step's edits, action and fault; a byte copy admitted cold
and a hot store bootstrapped from it judge the result against the model
observe the settled point: the owner's phase, the operation gate,
the generation pins, the slot that the catalog selects, the
predecessor's appointed pack prefix, any pack suffix, the files
and the five journals
apply the step's edits to the hot store under the gate's read side:
puts and removals of data, continuations and joins, a join removal
refused while its group holds a continuation; in an open phase the
gate is held and every edit is blocked
normalize the action on the model to one that the phase admits;
a seeded history must keep every action and edit as written
arm the fault inside the owner's AfterPreparation hook, so it
binds to the publication that the owner actually runs: a failpoint
at one of the hooks 2 to 14, an I/O failpoint, or a torn slot prefix
yes
a faulted checkpoint?
no
call the owner under observed_effects: a checkpoint, a minimal
checkpoint, a checkpoint cancelled at the gate, a reconcile (also
under zero admission limits or under a decoy at the store's
pathname), or a restart by path; the hook trace, the cold
admissions and the index constructions must match the action
phase after the call?
published once, empty, cancelled,
reconciled, retried or restarted:
the journals are empty or unchanged,
the gate is free, and only the
adopted generation is pinned
a faulted checkpoint: its outcome class
keeps the predecessor or selects the exact
terminal, the predecessor's prefix is
unchanged; or a zero-limit reconcile is
refused; the gate stays held and the
journals are unchanged
the successor pin overflowed after
the publication: the terminal is
retained and unpinned, the old pin
is kept, the gate stays held, and
the next retry acknowledges once
check the settled point: phase, gate, pins, the selected slot, the
predecessor's appointed prefix and at most one new generation; in
Ready, the hot store read under the gate's read side equals the model
The independent judge
The copy shares no lease, registry or
process state with the live owner, and
its admission and bootstrap run outside
every observed_effects window, so they
never count toward a step's effects.
judge: copy the store byte for byte into a fresh directory and admit
the copy cold with its own lease registry; its slot, its generation
and its contents must equal the model's durable state, and so must
a hot store bootstrapped from it with empty journals
Ready
AwaitingAck
RecoveryRequired
